decisions.rationale: 'FRDA' here is the gene symbol for the gene carrying the 'point mutation' (G130V is a mutation in the FRDA gene), not a reference to the disease, so it is not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene-symbol usage is not a disease mention)

decisions.rationale: 'Friedreich ataxia' names one specific disease with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease and is annotated as the full string.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease); Examples §5 (prefer the minimum span for the most specific form)

decisions.rationale: 'FRDA' in parentheses is the abbreviation of Friedreich ataxia, so it is annotated as a separate Specific Disease mention from the long form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §6 (synonymous mentions; abbreviation separated from long form)

decisions.rationale: 'inherited ataxia' refers to a family of multiple specific ataxias that are inherited, not one single disease, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Disease Class); Examples §10 and §12 (family of diseases)

decisions.rationale: 'FRDA' here appears in 'the affected gene, FRDA' and refers to the gene where expansions occur, not to the disease itself.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene-symbol usage is not a disease mention)

decisions.rationale: 'FRDA' in 'exon 4 of FRDA' names the gene location of the G130V mutation, not the disease, so it is not annotated as a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene-symbol usage is not a disease mention)

decisions.rationale: In 'atypical FRDA phenotype' the disease name FRDA modifies the noun 'phenotype', so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §3 (disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts)
